questionAnalysis.valueDetail: On average {} of the exam's {} points — {}× the value of an ordinary question.
questionAnalysis.valueNone: This question's subcategory is never drawn by the exam — not once in any of the {} official variants.
questionAnalysis.valueHelp:
Value = probability of being drawn × points. It is what not knowing this question costs you on an average exam. An “ordinary question” is the average value of all questions that can appear at all.

Computed from {} official exam variants and the {} questions in the bank.
questionAnalysis.probabilityTitle: Chance of being on the exam
questionAnalysis.probabilityHelp:
The question belongs to a group of {}, from which the exam draws exactly {}. It occurs {} times in the official sample of {} variants.

The probability comes from the reconstructed exam blueprint rather than from the sample frequency: {} variants are far too few to estimate each question directly.
questionAnalysis.difficultyThin: Not much data yet; the estimate is pulled towards the average.
questionAnalysis.difficultyHelp:
The share of wrong answers to this question across all users of the app. Answers: {}, learners: {}.

While there are few answers the estimate is pulled towards the bank average ({}%), so that a couple of accidental mistakes do not make a question “hard”.
questionAnalysis.difficultyGuest: Sign in to see how often other learners get this one wrong.
questionAnalysis.difficultyUnavailable: Nobody has answered this question yet.
questionAnalysis.difficultyFailed: Could not load the difficulty data.
questionAnalysis.keywordWholeCorrect: “{}” — this whole answer is always correct: it is in all {} questions of the bank where it occurs.
questionAnalysis.keywordWholeWrong: “{}” — this whole answer is always wrong: it is in all {} questions of the bank where it occurs.
questionAnalysis.keywordPhraseCorrect: “{}” — always a correct answer: in all {} options of the bank containing this phrase.
questionAnalysis.keywordPhraseWrong: “{}” — always a wrong answer: in all {} options of the bank containing this phrase.
questionAnalysis.keywordLink: If the question contains “{}”, the answer “{}” is correct — it is in all {} questions of the bank where it is offered.
questionAnalysis.keywordNone: None of this question's options contain a phrase that decides the answer across the bank. Learn it on its merits.
questionAnalysis.keywordsHighlighted: These phrases are highlighted in the question and in the answers above.
questionAnalysis.keywordsHelp:
Phrases and whole answers that, across the bank of {} questions, occur only in correct (or only in wrong) options — something to memorise the answer by. Only clear-cut cases count; “almost always” is not shown. {} questions have such cues.

A link “if the question contains … → this answer is correct” is shown when the answer itself is sometimes right and sometimes wrong in the bank, but always right when that word is in the question.

The phrases are quoted in Serbian — the language the questions are written in and the exam is sat in; the translation under an option is only there to help you read it.

These are bank-wide statistics, not a rule: always check the answer on its merits.

subscription.remindersSubtitle: 14 and 3 days before the subscription ends. Order and payment e-mails always arrive.
subscription.oneTimeNote: One payment for the whole term. Nothing is charged automatically — the subscription simply ends, and we remind you in advance.

billingAdmin.title: Payments and subscriptions

billingAdmin.manualTitle: Grant / change the subscription by hand
billingAdmin.manualHint: “Grant” sets the chosen feature set (the basic → Russian upgrade is done with it too), “Extend” adds months to the current set, “Revoke” closes the current and queued periods.
billingAdmin.revokeBody: The current and queued periods of {email} close — access is gone on the next request.
billingAdmin.auditHint: Money operations: who did what and when.
billingAdmin.tariffsHint: Prices live in the database — change them without a release. A price is saved when you leave the field.
billingAdmin.payeeHint: The bank details every payment slip and IPS QR is issued for. The account number is checked against its control digits (model 97). Once saved, every pending order gets the details — in the app and in the e-mails.
billingAdmin.payeeConfigured: Payee details are set: pending orders carry a payment slip and an IPS QR.
